tagline: Migrate or sync tasks between Asana projects and Trello boards
metaTitle: Asana + Trello Integration: Asana Tasks to Trello Cards
metaDescription: Create Trello cards from new Asana tasks, sync card moves back to Asana, and migrate projects in bulk. GAIA keeps tasks and boards in step. See the setup steps.
intro:
The two tools approach project management differently — Asana with structured task hierarchies and timelines, Trello with visual Kanban boards — but many teams rely on both. Client-facing work might live on the boards for their simplicity while internal project tracking uses the more powerful features of the task hierarchy. Without automation, teams must update both tools manually, creating delays and inconsistencies.

GAIA connects them so tasks move between the two tools automatically. New tasks can become cards, card movements can update task statuses, and deadlines stay consistent across both tools. Teams can collaborate in their preferred interface while the underlying data stays unified.

This integration is ideal for agencies managing client boards in Trello while tracking internal project timelines in Asana, and for teams transitioning between the two tools who need a reliable migration path.

useCases.title: Create Trello cards from new Asana tasks
useCases.description: When a task is added to a project, GAIA automatically creates a corresponding card in the appropriate list, complete with the task title, description, due date, and assignee.

useCases.title: Sync Trello card moves back to Asana
useCases.description: When a card moves from In Progress to Done, GAIA marks the linked task as complete, keeping both tools consistent without requiring team members to update two systems.

useCases.title: Bulk migrate projects to boards
useCases.description: GAIA reads all tasks in a project and creates a fully populated board with lists mapped to sections, making platform transitions smooth and data-complete.

useCases.title: Deadline synchronization
useCases.description: GAIA monitors due dates in both tools and alerts the team when dates diverge, ensuring that deadline changes made in one tool are reflected in the other before they cause scheduling conflicts.

useCases.title: Client board updates from internal tracking
useCases.description: When internal milestones are reached, GAIA updates the corresponding card in the client-facing board, giving clients real-time progress visibility without exposing internal project details.

howItWorks.step: Authorize Asana and Trello in GAIA
howItWorks.description: Connect your Asana workspace and Trello account to GAIA. GAIA maps projects to boards and sections to lists based on your configuration.

howItWorks.step: Set sync direction and field mappings
howItWorks.description: Choose whether to sync one-way or bidirectionally. Configure which fields carry over, title, description, due date, assignee, labels, between the two tools.
Once configured, GAIA monitors both tools and propagates changes automatically, keeping tasks and cards consistent so your team always works from accurate data.

faqs.question: Can GAIA sync subtasks to checklists?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can convert subtasks into card checklists, preserving the hierarchical structure of your work items even though the two data models differ.

faqs.question: What happens to Asana custom fields when syncing to Trello?
faqs.answer: Custom fields that have a card equivalent are mapped automatically. Fields without a direct counterpart are appended to the card description so no information is lost.

faqs.question: Is this suitable for a permanent sync or just a one-time migration?
faqs.answer: Both. GAIA supports ongoing bidirectional sync for teams running both tools in parallel, as well as one-time migration jobs for teams moving from one tool to the other in either direction.
